course_name_original: Projecto Integrador de 1º Ciclo em Engenharia Informática e de Computadores (PLic231110)
course_name_en: 1st Cycle Integrating Project in Computer Science and Engineering
syllabus_topics: Scientific project: an in-depth and academically rigorous analysis of a scientific, technological or management challenge, possibly including experimental and/or computational work.
Project in a company: individual project focused on a specific challenge presented by the host company that requires a solution or analysis geared towards short-term implementation.

JUNO Project: multidisciplinary teamwork based on real and complex problems/challenges presented by companies or institutions that require contributions from students from different IST/ULisboa courses.
assessment_rules: The minimum final grade is 9.5 (without rounding). Projects are done in groups of 2 students. For special, extraordinary, and worker-student periods, the evaluation is the same as the normal period, except the project can be done individually. Deliveries after the deadline incur a 25% discount up to 5 working days late, and a 50% discount for 5 working days or more. The final grade is calculated as E1 + E2 + PR1 + (E3 + E4 + PR2) x C + E5 + E6, where E refers to deliveries, PR to PR management, and C is a complexity factor for functionality.
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LEIC-A Eng. Informática e de Computadores (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática e de Computadores - Alameda (LEIC-A)
